# Finlexia

> > Leading Turkish accounting and tax services firm in Istanbul providing comprehensive financial, compliance, and corporate solutions for businesses in Türkiye.

Finlexia is a professional accounting firm based in Istanbul specializing in Turkish tax compliance, corporate services, and financial reporting for domestic and foreign companies. The firm offers expertise in Turkish Commercial Code compliance, IFRS/TFRS reporting, payroll management, and corporate governance.
